question:
(a) State de Broglie hypothesis and obtain the expression for the wavelength of an electron accelerated through a potential difference $V$.
(b) Explain how the Davisson and Germer experiment confirmed this hypothesis.

options.A:
(a) de Broglie proposed $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{p}$. For an electron, $eV=\dfrac{p^2}{2m}$, so $p=\sqrt{2meV}$ and $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{\sqrt{2meV}}$.
(b) Electron scattering from nickel crystal produced diffraction maxima, and the observed wavelength matched de Broglie wavelength, confirming the wave nature of electrons.
options.B:
(a) de Broglie proposed $\lambda=hp$.
(b) Davisson and Germer experiment proved electrons have only particle nature.
options.C:
(a) $\lambda=\dfrac{h}{eV}$.
(b) The experiment measured only electron charge.
options.D:
(a) Matter waves exist only for stationary particles.
(b) The nickel crystal emitted photons, proving the wave nature of light only.
